What's New in Project Looking Glass

This page is generated from CHANGELOG.md by scripts/mandela/whats-new.mnd and shows the unreleased work plus the three most recent releases. Refresh it with ./gradlew :lg3d-mandela:whatsNewRefresh after editing the changelog - never edit this HTML, a CI gate compares it against the changelog line by line.

Unreleased — 1.69.0-dev — Gradle / JDK 21 modernization

Added

  • The server session layer gains its three missing judgements — roadmap P5.4 (wonderland-server)
  • Bloom maths, and the post-processing ceiling stated as a decision — roadmap P3.2 (wonderland-renderer)
  • A follow rig and a spline tour, as frame-rate-independent maths — roadmap P3.1 (wonderland-client)
  • Spatial audio, with a backend that degrades when there is no device — roadmap P4.1 (wonderland-client)
  • Shadow maths gets its projector, and the culler gets its owner — roadmap P2.4 (wonderland-renderer + wonderland-client)
  • The shader-vs-fixed decision as data, and a measured platform ceiling — roadmap P2.2 (wonderland-renderer)
  • Normal and specular maps have a place to live in the appearance — roadmap P2.1 (wonderland-renderer)
  • The eye probe, formalised — roadmap P5.3 (wonderland-client + lg3d-apps)
  • The clinic ships its first real behaviour script — roadmap P5.2 (wonderland-server resources + lg3d-apps)
  • The scene goes physical: PVS culling, real collision, trigger zones — roadmap P0.2 / P1.1 / P1.2 (wonderland-client)
  • Mandela cell behaviours for Wonderland — roadmap P5.1 (lg3d-apps)
  • Opt-in lighting for the renderer, and the Wonderland 3D roadmap (wonderland-renderer + docs)
  • A walk-in that talks: text chat on the cell channel (wonderland-common + wonderland-server + wonderland-client)
  • The walk-in window gains a sidebar, and the world stops stealing the keyboard (wonderland-renderer + lg3d-apps)
  • The clinic's hall is furnished: six wall cards, authored as GUI cells (wonderland-server)
  • The world browser can now start the world it shows — and shows what it starts (wonderland-server + lg3d-apps)
  • The Wonderland client session went production: the world is now seen, not just listed (wonderland-client + lg3d-apps)
  • The Wonderland World browser became a world picker with Start/Stop server control (wonderland-server + lg3d-apps)
  • Wonderland server became startable (wonderland-server, gradle, root build.gradle)
  • The Wonderland server can host a world — the outpatient clinic seeds (wonderland-server + wonderland-modules)
  • Access to every existing Wonderland world, plus the world-library agent guide (wonderland-server + wonderland-modules + wonderland-server/AGENTS.md)
  • The world's art is served over HTTP — the first Stage-2 walk pieces (wonderland-server)
  • The model URL now crosses the shared wire format — Stage 2 complete (wonderland-common + wonderland-renderer + wonderland-server)
  • Mandela got a version of its own (lg3d-mandela, gradle.properties, scripts/mandela)
  • Mandela 1.1.0: the roadmap's next horizon landed whole (lg3d-mandela, scripts/mandela, docs/mandela-language.md)
  • A release is now a page, and the page carries its test reports (scripts/mandela + documentation/ + .github/workflows/)
  • Wonderland reaches the desktop — the M6c2 integration, in 2D and 3D (wonderland-desktop + lg3d-apps + lg3d-core)
  • The Wonderland VoIP softphone lands on ice4j + Java Sound + in-tree G.711 (wonderland-modules + lg3d-apps, M7d)
  • Wonderland avatar animation lands on COLLADA keyframes (wonderland-modules + wonderland-renderer + wonderland-avatars + wonderland-desktop, M7c)
  • The Wonderland pdfviewer lands on Apache PDFBox (wonderland-modules + lg3d-apps, M7b)
  • The Wonderland videoplayer lands on OpenJFX Media (wonderland-modules + lg3d-apps, M7a)
  • The Wonderland scene-graph bridge lands — a cell's world mounts inside the lg3d desktop (wonderland-desktop, new module)
  • The Wonderland avatar renderer lands on the bundled .dae pool (wonderland-avatars new module, wonderland-renderer M6b)
  • The Wonderland Collada cell renderer lands on the Jogamp stack (wonderland-renderer, new module)
  • The Wonderland COLLADA / deployed-model / asset pipeline lands, headless (wonderland-modules, src/main/java/…/modules/collada/, src/main/java/…/modules/artimport/, src/main/java/…/modules/asset/, src/test/java/…/modules/, src/test/resources/wonderland-almostempty-world/)
  • The Wonderland plugin loader lands, headless, with the first five modules (wonderland-modules, src/main/java/…/modules/, src/main/java/…/modules/api/, src/main/resources/META-INF/services/, src/test/java/…/modules/)
  • The Wonderland session/host server binds real sockets and multiplexes one session over a client's three connections (wonderland-server, src/main/java/…/server/ws/, src/main/resources/application.properties, src/test/java/…/server/ws/)
  • The Wonderland session/host server lands on Spring Boot (wonderland-server, src/main/java/…/server/, src/test/java/…/server/)
  • The Wonderland view/avatar movement core lands, headless (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/cell/, src/main/java/…/client/cell/view/, src/main/java/…/client/utils/)
  • The Wonderland connection/session layer lands, headless (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/comms/ + src/main/java/…/client/cell/, src/test/java/…/comms/)
  • The Wonderland cell cache registry lands, headless (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/cell/, src/test/java/…/cell/)
  • The Wonderland Cell base class lands, headless (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/cell/, src/test/java/…/cell/; wonderland-common, src/main/java/com/jme/…)
  • The Wonderland client gains its first real logic — the cell registry and the comms response substrate (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/{cell,comms}/, src/test/java/…/{cell/utils,comms}/)
  • The Wonderland client's cell layer starts landing bottom-up (wonderland-client, src/main/java/…/client/cell/, src/test/java/…/cell/)
  • The Wonderland wire protocol is now a tested contract (wonderland-common, src/test/java/…/messages/, …/comms/messages/, …/cell/messages/)
  • The Wonderland migration begins with a JDK-21 data-model foundation (wonderland-common, wonderland-client, wonderland-server, wonderland-modules; docs/wonderland-migration.md)
  • A published page demonstrating the language in everyday use (lg3d-mandela/docs/USAGE.md, mirrored on the GitHub Pages site as documentation/mandela/docs/USAGE.md)
  • A published history of the language (lg3d-mandela/docs/HISTORY.md, mirrored on the GitHub Pages site as documentation/mandela/docs/HISTORY.md)
  • The Help Center now writes its own What's New page from the CHANGELOG (lg3d-apps, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.help + scripts/mandela/)
  • Project Mandela's module documentation is now published on the GitHub Pages portal (documentation/, mirrors lg3d-mandela/docs/)
  • A crash-report pipeline that turns a crash into a GitHub issue without ever holding a credential (lg3d-core, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.crash)
  • The noise rules are what makes it usable (lg3d-core, CrashReporter)
  • A SEVERE log record is a bug report too (lg3d-core, LogHandler)
  • 123 headless tests for the crash package (lg3d-core, src/test/java/org/jdesktop/lg3d/displayserver/crash/)
  • A Bug Reporter app — the manual half of the crash-reporting tool (lg3d-apps, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.bugreporter; lg3d-core, Desktop2DAppRegistry)
  • Internationalisation of the shell — the desktop can now speak French (lg3d-core, org.jdesktop.lg3d.i18n; lg3d-apps, Control Center)
  • The runaway-loop guard finally has a test, and two gates join the repository checks (lg3d-mandela, vm/VM + MachineHostTest; scripts/mandela/)
  • Two Mandela scripts now police the desktop's own runtime configuration (scripts/mandela, lg3d-mandela/build.gradle, root AGENTS.md)

Fixed

  • The meeting complex's pond vanished between the .mtg and the renderer — roadmap P2.3 (wonderland-modules + wonderland-renderer)
  • Walking into the clinic crashed on every resident, because a seeded AvatarCell was put on the wire as a plain CellClientState (wonderland-server + wonderland-client)
  • A live walk-in crashed the desktop on entering any world, because the server broadcast an abstract class as the environment root (wonderland-client + wonderland-server)
  • A cell's width and depth were the square of the room, so the world browser's floor plan drew a 5.4 m exam room as a 58 m one (wonderland-server)
  • Every cell heading in every world was silently dropped, so a turned object drew facing north and a poster read as missing art (wonderland-renderer)
  • The clinic's hall had no ceiling, because its faces looked the wrong way and nothing asked (wonderland-server)
  • A world's own text read upside down over every head, because one upload inverted and only half the cards were told (wonderland-renderer)
  • The Wonderland World panel dead-ended on "Cannot reach", and a seeded world spammed the boot log (lg3d-apps + wonderland-common + wonderland-server)
  • The Update Manager's What's New had nothing to show, because its parser did not recognise this repository's changelog (update-manager)
  • No wonderland jar was on the desktop's classpath, so the Wonderland applications shipped since M7a could not run (lg3d-core + lg3d-apps)
  • WorldInputRouter did not read the abstract mouse-motion class as a hover (wonderland-desktop)
  • A parsed COLLADA document lost the author's order, and the avatar clip list shuffled itself (wonderland-modules, wonderland-renderer)
  • indexOf now honours its start index instead of ignoring it (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • The release train no longer cuts releases by itself (.github/workflows/release-train.yml)
  • A class's construction counts its initialiser's parameters, not its fields (lg3d-mandela, vm/VM)
  • The host re-entrancy limit reports the depth that was reached (lg3d-mandela, vm/VM)
  • An Int operation that overflows promotes to Double instead of answering with its left operand (lg3d-mandela, values/Operators)
  • A closure can capture a variable owned by a grandparent function (lg3d-mandela, code/Compiler)
  • The guide described a range as exclusive of its end (docs/mandela-language.md)
  • A host function's Java answer is converted at the machine, like a bound name is (lg3d-mandela, vm/VM)
  • A bare ## [Unreleased] header no longer turns release-check red (scripts/mandela/release-check.mnd)
  • std.json refuses the numbers RFC 8259 refuses (lg3d-mandela, rt/Json)
  • A Java value handed to the writer crosses the table the machine uses (lg3d-mandela, rt/Json)
  • A wide Double is written with a signed exponent (lg3d-mandela, rt/Json)
  • abs of the most negative Int promotes instead of wrapping (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • padStart/padEnd honour the text ceiling repeat already enforced (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • int(...) refuses a double with no Int instead of saturating (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • A Range offers only the copying sorting spellings (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • A call missing its second argument is told it needs two (lg3d-mandela, rt/StandardLibrary)
  • A downward Range lost its last value (lg3d-mandela, values/MandelaRange)
  • == compared only the top level of a container (lg3d-mandela, values/MandelaList, MandelaMap, MandelaInstance)
  • A container's hash disagreed with its equality (lg3d-mandela, values), the other half of the same bug: 1 and 1.0 are equal but hashed apart, so a script that used a List as a set or a map key got a different bucket for the same value. Values.hash is the canonical hash for every value
  • Two Doubles that are the same number were unequal (lg3d-mandela, values/Values)
  • A big Int comparison collapsed two distinct numbers (lg3d-mandela, values/Values)
  • A Double was printed with placeholder zeros (lg3d-mandela, values/Values)
  • x as Any returned the text of the value (lg3d-mandela, values/Values)

Changed

  • The clinic is one building, not eight boxes on a field (wonderland-server)
  • The lg3d-core coverage floor is raised to 0.225 line / 0.310 branch (build.gradle)
  • The language guide now says what the machine does (docs/mandela-language.md)
  • The values package is at every line covered (lg3d-mandela)
  • The lg3d-mandela coverage floor is raised to 0.890 line / 0.780 branch (build.gradle)
  • The root AGENTS.md no longer claims that no coverage gate is enforced
  • Name-resolution tags in the compiler are an enum (Compiler.Ref), not int constants
  • Operators.div dropped the two conditions it could never need
  • The language guide's LimitError entry covers the library's ceilings too (docs/mandela-language.md)

Removed

  • The value surface no receiver can reach (lg3d-mandela, values)
  • Ast.BlockValue, an expression node no syntax could produce (lg3d-mandela)
  • StandardLibrary.needList, a guard no script could reach (lg3d-mandela)

Changed

Added

  • LFS system management Phase 3b: Network panel backend detection & fallback (lg3d-apps, lg3d-core)
  • LFS system management Phase 4a: Security — nftables / AppArmor / SELinux / SSH over real backends (lg3d-apps, lg3d-core)
  • LFS system management Phase 4b: Privacy — tor over the init abstraction (lg3d-apps, lg3d-core)

1.64.0 — 2026-10-07 — Gradle / JDK 21 modernization

Added

Fixed
